evidence: Static waypoint observations/potential and a pitch-action neutral pose; no prescribed XYZ trajectory, joint drive injection, external forces, or state resets during motion.
floor_front_reference: 82 poses from true floor contact to first FR plant; three other feet stay on floor. Interpolated geometry sampled without collisions, physical motor bounds pass; not dynamically demonstrated.
rear_reference: 105 static candidates; rear-foot connecting path and support flattening remain unproven.
pitch_mapping: Within guided variants, normalized command is b+(1-b)*a for a>=0, b+(1+b)*a otherwise. b is reference pitch/110 deg. a=-1/+1 retains full -110/+110 deg range. Existing filter, IK and motor guards remain.

front_reset_static_load.assumption: specified stance corners, friction pyramid, bounded PD setpoint headroom

combined_experiment: new grounded front reference/reset and pose-centered pitch mapping; not a one-factor ablation against rear-only guidance
